01 About me

Turning ideas into production-ready apps.

I’m a Senior Mobile Application Developer with 10+ years in the software industry, of which 6+ years are in Flutter and Dart. I build mobile applications for Android, iOS and Web, with Flutter as my main stack.

I mentor teams on SOLID principles and testing, lead code reviews, and build AI-assisted workflows with Claude Code and Claude Design, with every change reviewed before release.

I have worked in many domains: HRMS, fintech, medical, e-commerce and food delivery. In every domain, I built apps that are easy for users to use.

I use Clean Architecture in my projects. For state management, I use Bloc, Provider and Riverpod.

I work with REST APIs and JSON every day. I build, integrate and test APIs, with secure calls and clear error handling.

I set up CI/CD pipelines that build, test and release the app automatically, so every change is checked before it reaches users.

I am good at debugging. I find problems and fix them fast. I also improve app performance.
